[1/3] Plan Scene/Game viewport modes with game-camera follow and Play auto-switch

impact_assessment.why: The viewport always uses the free editor camera, so there is no Game view that follows the scene camera and Play mode never cuts to the game camera.
impact_assessment.benefits: A Scene/Game toggle keeps editor navigation in Scene view, follows the live scene camera in Game view, suppresses selection/gizmos there, and auto-switches on Play/Stop.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI-only, no API/schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: pointer arbitration with orbit, gizmos and box select; state: camera-state restoration, live scene refresh, auto-switch transitions, selection and gizmo suppression.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Store and restore the editor camera, derive the game camera from scene yaw/pitch/position, guard pointer/wheel/gizmo/box paths by mode, switch only on play transitions, and add static viewer/console regressions.

[1/3] Plan refreshing authored prefab instances after a template edit, skipping overridden and nested groups

impact_assessment.why: Saving a prefab edit leaves existing authored instances stale until each one is reverted or applied by hand.
impact_assessment.benefits: refresh_prefab_instances replaces every safe instance group with the current template in one undo entry and reports refreshed/skipped counts for AI clients.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 34 and one new action; dependency: none; concurrency: editor lock; state: override detection, nested groups, split groups, undo atomicity, missing prefabs, blocked prefab-edit mode.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Skip groups with overrides, nested or split roots, refresh top-level groups only, wrap the whole pass in one history entry, and add refresh/override/undo regressions.

[1/3] Plan Scene-view grid and persistent snap toggle with console controls

impact_assessment.why: Scene view has no ground grid and snapping only works while Ctrl/Cmd is held, which slows precise authoring.
impact_assessment.benefits: A visible 1-unit grid with major lines and colored axes, plus Grid and Snap toggles, gives Unity/Unreal-style precision editing in Scene view.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI-only, no API/schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: pointer arbitration unchanged; state: line rendering depth, Game-view suppression, snap increments and toggle persistence.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Draw the grid with the existing line shader in Scene view only, keep depth testing, route gizmo rounding through one snap predicate, and add static viewer/console regressions.

[1/3] Plan saving the multi-selection as a multi-root prefab

impact_assessment.why: The editor can insert and manage multi-root prefabs, but save_prefab only captures one node, so a multi-selection cannot become a prefab.
impact_assessment.benefits: save_prefab accepts an ordered ids list, filters selected descendants, requires one parent, captures a multi-root template, and the console uses the whole selection automatically.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 35 and save_prefab payload extension; dependency: none; concurrency: editor lock; state: duplicate/descendant selection, mixed parents, name fallback, library rollback, selection restore.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Deduplicate ids in selection order, drop descendants of selected roots, require a shared parent, reuse Prefab.from_nodes, keep single-id behavior, and add multi-root save/insert/error regressions.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Multi-root prefab capture implemented: save_prefab accepts ordered ids, dedupes and folds selected descendants, requires one parent, captures via Prefab.from_nodes, preserves single-id behavior, console sends the whole selection, schema 35; 765 tests green, Ruff clean, node checks clean, determinism hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde, headless/describe schema 35, AIKit 6/6; checklists: passed

[1/3] Plan perspective/orthographic top/front/side view presets for the Scene view

impact_assessment.why: The Scene view is perspective-only, so axis-aligned authoring that Unity/Unreal users expect from top/front/side orthographic views is unavailable.
impact_assessment.benefits: A projection button cycles Persp/Top/Front/Side, orthographic projection uses the editor camera distance for zoom, and existing grid, picking, gizmos and view modes keep working.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI-only, no API/schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: pointer arbitration unchanged; state: projection math, camera preset orientation, Game-view perspective, reset/focus behavior, near-plane picking.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a standard orthographic matrix, switch projection only in Scene view, orient the existing camera state for each preset, keep Game view perspective, and add static viewer/console regressions.

[1/3] Plan a console panel for per-field prefab override inspection, revert and apply

impact_assessment.why: The API reports per-field prefab overrides, but the console hides them, so resolving an override still requires hand-written API calls.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each instance/node/field row shows template and instance values with Revert and Apply buttons, making prefab divergence visible and resolvable in the editor.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI-only, no API/schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: editor lock; state: DOM safety for arbitrary values, group errors, asset-write apply, undoable revert, busy guards.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Render with textContent and createElement, keep per-field actions on existing endpoints, refresh the scene after each action, and add static console regressions.
